note: Claude Code appends its own environment block (date, platform, working directory, model name, account identity, generic tool-safety notes) to every request; the judge system and user messages are otherwise sent as logged in calls.jsonl.
thinking_mode_meaning: 'disabled' = reasoning (extended thinking) off; otherwise the effort level with thinking on
refusal_fallback: none: every score comes from the judge model
reply_format: one call per judgment; the score is the JSON score object the reply consists of or ends with (a reply that also carries a written rationale is kept, not repeated)
